title: Nvidia to buy $10B of Anthropic stock at IPO price

sources.quote: At the $74 midpoint of Anthropic's price range, Nvidia's $10 billion would buy around 135 million shares.

explain: In an amended IPO filing, Anthropic said Nvidia agreed to buy about $10 billion of its shares in a private placement at the IPO price. The filing does not say whether this is part of Nvidia's earlier pledge to invest up to $10 billion.
